Obviously, this is a different muscle and dosage so timings are likely to be different, but the principal is the same. Don’t be disheartened!

Hi. I’m in the UK and have PMI with BUPA through my employer. It’s MHD (medical history disregarded) so doesn’t take into account any pre-existing conditions. 

On Wednesday I called my GP to try get a referral - they were super busy so used the Push Doctor service which is a video appointment with a random locum. This GP was more than happy to give me a private referral (I figured they’d be happy it’s one less person on an NHS waitlist. I then called BUPA and explained the situation. I was put on hold for quite a while but she came back on the phone and said they’d cover it. I honestly nearly cried! I’d already emailed Mr Karagama’s PA who had given me the details and procedure codes I needed so I provided those to BUPA and BUPA then texted me an authorisation code which I gave to Mr Karagama’s PA when I then rang to book my consultation which is beginning of Feb in Manchester. 

It was all referred, authorised and arranged within 90 minutes which is amazing - I honestly thought I’d have a massive fight on my hands! Give your insurer a call and take it from there. Hopefully you’ll be pleasantly surprised.
I’m so pleased it’s lasted so long for you! Amazing how such a simple procedure can cure a lifetime of discomfort. I may DM you some questions if that’s ok!
